# Chris Colangelo
## Chris Colangelo
### Title
**Christopher R. Colangelo** is a Hot Wheels designer who has been working with Mattel since 2013 . He is the design lead on the Hot Wheels Mario Kart series vehicles, Star Wars playsets, the Star Wars Starships line, design lead on San Diego Comic-Con exclusives and has worked on other major licenses for Hot Wheels, such as DC.
